ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Suhuf Musa' in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to the Quraysh, reminding them of the Tawrat (Torah) to validate the continuity of prophetic truth. It underscores the concept of *Tawatur* (mass transmission) of earlier scriptures, asserting that the core message of monotheism remains unchanged across revelations.
